privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data NextCampus processes, why, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: NextCampus provides an online admission test preparation platform. For accounts created directly with us, NextCampus is responsible for your data. When a coaching center or institution manages its own workspace, it is responsible for the data it manages about its members, and NextCampus processes it on their behalf.

sections.heading: Data we collect
items: Account data: name, display name, email address, profile photo from your sign-in provider, time zone, language and digit preferences.
Membership data: the workspaces you belong to, your role, and invitations sent to you.
Security data: sign-in events, password changes and administrative actions recorded in audit logs.
Messages you send us through the contact form.

sections.heading: How we use data
items: To sign you in and enforce the access each workspace grants.
To send transactional emails such as verification, password reset and invitations.
To keep the platform secure and investigate abuse.
To send product updates, only if you opt in from your settings.

sections.heading: Who can see your data
paragraphs: Other students never see your profile, email or membership. In a coaching center or institution workspace, its administrators and instructors can see the members of that workspace. We do not sell personal data.
We share data only with infrastructure providers that host the service (database, authentication, email delivery) under contracts that require them to protect it.

sections.heading: Retention
paragraphs: Account data is kept while your account is active. Audit logs are kept to protect the integrity of the platform and may remain after your membership ends.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can view and correct your profile in settings, and request a copy or deletion of your data through the contact page.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of NextCampus. By creating an account you agree to them.

sections.heading: Accounts
paragraphs: Provide accurate information and keep your password secure. You are responsible for activity under your account. Tell us immediately if you suspect unauthorized access.

sections.heading: Preparation, not official information
paragraphs: NextCampus is an independent preparation service. It is not affiliated with any university or admission authority. Always rely on official admission circulars for dates, eligibility and rules.

sections.heading: Workspaces
paragraphs: A coaching center or institution that creates a workspace is responsible for the members it invites and the roles it assigns.

sections.heading: Plans and payment
paragraphs: The Free plan is free. Paid plans are not on sale yet; their prices and terms will be published before launch and apply only if you choose to buy.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
paragraphs: You must follow our Acceptable Use Policy.

sections.heading: Suspension and changes
paragraphs: We may suspend accounts that break these terms or put others at risk. We will notify you of material changes to these terms before they take effect.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use policy
acceptableUse.intro: NextCampus exists to help students prepare honestly. This policy describes conduct that is not allowed.

sections.heading: Integrity
items: Do not share accounts or let someone else take a test for you.
Do not copy or redistribute NextCampus practice content.

sections.heading: Security
items: Do not try to access another person’s or organization’s data.
Report suspected vulnerabilities through the contact page using the Security topic.

sections.heading: Abuse
items: Do not send unsolicited invitations or spam.
Do not upload unlawful or hateful content.

sections.heading: Enforcement
paragraphs: Violations may lead to removal of content and suspension of accounts or workspaces.
